notes.title: v1.0.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] There is a problem that the window mode switching does not work properly, so the borderless windowed mode is temporarily disabled.

[*] Fixed an issue where the waypoints in some areas were not working properly.

[*] Attempted to fix a bug that caused a low chance to return to the starting point when loading a saved game. (Please let us know if this problem still occurs.)

[*] DualShock 4(PS4 controller) support was added. (If it doesn't work properly, please let us know.)[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Critical bugs have been fixed first. Minor bugs that don't significantly affect the game's progress will be fixed in subsequent patches.


[h2]System[/h2]
[list][*] The default windowed mode has been changed to borderless windowed. (Options for windowed mode will be added soon.)[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where if a player's character died at the same time as the boss was defeated, the cutscene would not end, making progress impossible.

[*] Fixed a bug where the Regeneration Talisman upgrade did not work properly.

[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player's character to get stuck in some traps and make progress impossible, when equipping an item that grants invincibility time.

[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash, when the player's character was killed in certain situations in the Circle of Binding boss battle.

[*] Fixed a bug in which special effects were displayed incorrectly when enhancing the 'Rune Sword' item.

[*] Fixed an issue that caused items to spawn in walls under certain circumstances when defeating the first Guardian of the Sanctuary of Light. (We have taken measures to respond even if this bug has already occurred.)

[*] Problems were found and fixed in puzzles in some areas.

[*] Fixed minor map-related bugs, such as icons not being displayed on the map or being displayed incorrectly.[/list]

notes.title: Introducing ASCENXION
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34821805/6aa741f271cc6722f649d33fecaee16c1f2d4f92.png[/img]

[b]ASCENXION[/b] is an upcoming shooting-adventure game by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/indigoblue]IndigoBlue Game Studio[/url], creator of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/449450/SPLIT_BULLET/]SPLIT BULLET[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/712870/Vectorium/]Vectorium[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/943510/Blindia/]Blindia[/url].

Combining shoot 'em up and adventure genre, the game deals with the story of a mysterious being that suddenly appeared in the unknown world. What secret would be hidden behind this world?

Stay tuned for further updates!
